summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Login and Forgot Password features for Auto Transport CRM. All backend tests passed (10/10). Frontend tests verified login flow, forgot password 3-step flow, branding, and error handling.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge is platform-injected and cannot be removed from code - this is expected behavior as noted in requirements

backend: Login with valid credentials (shumail.s / HONDA@2026) returns 200 with token
Login with wrong password returns 401 with error message
Login with wrong username returns 401 with error message
Forgot password with valid superadmin username returns security question
Forgot password with invalid username returns 404
Reset password with wrong security answer returns 401
Reset password with correct answer (Shark) successfully resets password
Reset password with short password (<6 chars) returns 400
Security answer is case-insensitive (shark, SHARK, Shark all work)
Rate limiting returns 429 after 5 wrong attempts
frontend: Login page loads with 'Shumail Technologies LLC' branding
Forgot Password link visible and navigates to /forgot-password
Login error messages display properly for wrong credentials
Forgot Password Step 1: Username entry works
Forgot Password Step 1: Wrong username shows error message
Forgot Password Step 2: Security question 'Who is your work?' displayed
Step indicators show correct active step
Back to Sign In link works from forgot password page
Login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard

critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiting is implemented correctly using in-memory defaultdict - note this resets on server restart
Security answer is properly hashed with bcrypt and compared case-insensitively
Password reset only works for superadmin users as intended
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing superadmin user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login and Forgot Password features are fully functional. Rate limiting is active (5 attempts per 15 minutes). Password was tested and restored to HONDA@2026. The 'Made with Emergent' badge is platform-injected and cannot be removed from code.
notes: The 'Made with Emergent' branding badge visible in screenshots is platform-injected by Emergent and cannot be removed from the application code - this was noted in the requirements as expected behavior.
